text_original: Collector paraphrase (not verbatim source text): In a twin test of a 2021 G80 3.5T AWD Prestige against a 2021 BMW 540i xDrive (G30, previous generation), the reviewer picks the G80 as the overall winner. Reviewer states the 540i (G30) felt consistently faster than the G80 despite less power, although the G80's 375-hp V6 has plenty of low-to-mid-range power. Reviewer finds the G80 V6 sounds a little industrial next to the BMW's straight-six. Reviewer rates the G80 the better cruiser that absorbs bumps well, while the 540i's ride is slightly firmer. Reviewer states the 540i feels considerably more agile on winding roads, while the G80 is happiest on quicker, straighter roads. Reviewer describes the G80's steering as light, while the 540i offers more weighting in either drive mode. Reviewer calls the G80 cabin one of the most impressive below six figures, with high-quality materials and a welcoming design, while the 540i interior is all-business. Reviewer states the BMW's seats are more comfortable and its occupants would be more comfortable overall. Reviewer notes the G80 offers 38.7 in of rear legroom versus 36.5 in in the 540i, with equal rear headroom. Reviewer prefers the G80's infotainment, praising its large screen and rotary controller. Reviewer credits the BMW with the better smartphone connection, including wireless pairing, which the 2021 G80 lacked. Reviewer states the G80's Lexicon audio has more power and clarity than the BMW's Harman Kardon system. Reviewer praises the G80's comprehensive standard driver-assistance suite and Blind Spot View Monitor, noting the BMW's systems need an extra-cost package. Reviewer states the G80's styling stands out with hardly a bad angle, while the 540i looks much like its predecessors. Reviewer states the G80 undercuts the 5 Series on price across the board. Reviewer notes the G80 3.5T AWD is rated 21 mpg combined versus 26 mpg for the 540i xDrive, roughly doubling five-year fuel cost. Original excerpt(s), from tool summaries: «The G80 is our pick out of this duo.»
